lines.text: What kind of future do you imagine for yourself? <long pause> Imagine using your IT skills to build a career in Japan and grow into an international IT engineer. <long pause> Today, that opportunity is becoming a reality through the Japanese IT Pathway Program. <long pause> The Japanese IT Pathway Program prepares Cambodian IT students for professional careers in Japan. <long pause> Students develop two essential skills: Japanese communication skills and practical IT skills. <long pause> They also learn professional communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and Japanese workplace culture. <long pause> Our goal is to develop IT professionals who can succeed in an international environment. <long pause> There is something very important that every student should understand. <long pause> This opportunity did not happen by accident. <long pause> The Cambodian government wants young people to gain international experience, develop their abilities, and contribute to Cambodia's future. <long pause> With support and financial investment from the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, M P T C, this program became possible. <long pause> This is a special educational opportunity supported by the Cambodian government. <long pause> The government is investing in education because it believes in your potential.
lines.style: Warm, sincere and inspiring documentary narration. Calm, clear and measured pace for students whose first language is not English. Leave a clear pause at every pause tag.

lines.text: Through this program, you can receive specialized education with strong government support. <long pause> Your teachers, your university, Next Make, and the government are all working together to support your growth. <long pause> But there is one thing nobody else can provide for you. <long pause> Your own commitment. <long pause> Learning Japanese and developing IT skills require effort. <long pause> Attend your classes, ask questions, and keep practicing every day. <long pause> Every small effort brings you closer to your goals. <long pause> These students show us how being punctual and studying every day can lead to remarkable growth. <long pause> The Cambodian government, your university, and Next Make are here to support you. <long pause> Now, the next step is yours. <long pause> Appreciate this opportunity, and commit yourself to learning. <long pause> Your future starts with your commitment. <long pause> Welcome to the Japanese IT Pathway Program.
